claims.claim: 2025-04-18: The Federal Reserve approved Capital One's application to merge with Discover Financial Services.
claims.quote: announced its approval of the application by Capital One Financial Corporation
claims.title: Federal Reserve Board announces approval of application by Capital One Financial Corporation
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Regulator press release; same day as OCC approval per Capital One 8-K.

claims.claim: 2025-04-18: Alongside approval, the Fed entered a consent order with Discover and fined it $100 million for overcharging interchange fees from 2007 through 2023 (the card product misclassification).
claims.quote: entered into a consent order with Discover and assessed a fine of $100 million for overcharging certain interchange fees
claims.title: Federal Reserve Board announces approval of application by Capital One Financial Corporation
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Directly partner-relevant: acquirers and merchants were overcharged; restitution flows via merchant class settlement.

claims.claim: 2025-04-18: As a condition of approval, Capital One committed to comply with the Fed's action against Discover including remediation requirements.
claims.quote: Capital One has committed that it will comply with the Board's action against Discover, including remediation requirements.
claims.title: Federal Reserve Board announces approval of application by Capital One Financial Corporation
claims.label: Verified

claims.claim: 2025-04-18 (reported 2025-04-21): Trade press reported the Fed and OCC approvals and a planned May 18 closing; Mastercard's CEO had earlier said Capital One was public about moving debit volume to the Discover network.
claims.quote: They have been public about transferring debit volume to the Discover network. There are no surprises fundamentally
claims.title: With The Final OKs, the Capital One-Discover Combo Sets a May 18 Closing
claims.label: Reported
claims.note: Quote is Mastercard CEO Michael Miebach as quoted by Digital Transactions (Q4 2024 earnings call). Article also states PULSE had $286 billion volume in 2023 vs Discover Network $264 billion.

claims.claim: 2025-05-18: Capital One completed its acquisition of Discover Financial Services; the Discover, PULSE and Diners Club International networks joined Capital One's offerings.
claims.quote: The Discover®, PULSE®, and Diners Club International® networks will join our suite of offerings.
claims.title: Capital One Completes Acquisition of Discover (Exhibit 99.1 to Form 8-K)
claims.publisher: Capital One Financial Corporation via SEC EDGAR
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: 8-K filed 2025-05-19. Press release states approvals by Fed and OCC on April 18, 2025 and Delaware State Bank Commissioner on December 18, 2024; stockholder votes February 18, 2025.

claims.claim: 2025-05-18: Capital One said it intends to keep offering Discover-branded credit cards alongside its own cards, and customer accounts were unchanged at closing.
claims.quote: Capital One intends to continue to offer Discover credit card products as Discover-branded cards alongside the other consumer cards
claims.title: Capital One Completes Acquisition of Discover (Exhibit 99.1 to Form 8-K)
claims.publisher: Capital One Financial Corporation via SEC EDGAR
claims.label: Verified

claims.claim: 2025-05-18: Capital One expanded its board from 12 to 15, appointing three former Discover directors (Maheras, Shepherd, Wong); Michael Shepherd had been Discover's interim CEO.
claims.quote: expanded its Board of Directors from 12 to 15 and appointed Thomas G. Maheras, Michael Shepherd, and Jennifer L. Wong
claims.title: Capital One Completes Acquisition of Discover (Exhibit 99.1 to Form 8-K)
claims.publisher: Capital One Financial Corporation via SEC EDGAR
claims.label: Verified

claims.claim: 2025-05 (leadership): Jason Hanson leads the Global Payment Network as President and joined Capital One's Executive Committee on completion of the acquisition; he is President and CEO of Discover Network and Chairman of PULSE and Diners Club International.
claims.quote: In May of 2025, Jason became a member of the Capital One Executive Committee upon completion of Capital One’s acquisition of Discover Financial Services.
claims.title: Discover Global Payment Network Leadership Team | Discover Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Page also says he served as EVP of the network July 2023 to May 2025 and sits on the ETA board.

claims.claim: 2025 (leadership): Post-acquisition network leadership includes Capital One transfers (Josh Atwood, SVP Global Acceptance; Hannes Endhardt, SVP Network Product and Platforms) and an ex-Visa hire, Natalie Kelly, as SVP Head of Network Risk Operations who joined in 2025.
claims.quote: Prior to joining the network in 2025, Natalie spent 25 years at Visa where she held various global leadership positions
claims.title: Discover Global Payment Network Leadership Team | Discover Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Atwood: 'Since joining Capital One in 2019'; Endhardt 'led Card Decisioning platforms at Capital One'. Partner-facing roles: acquirers, PSPs, merchants, U.S./Canada issuing (Jennifer Cruz).

claims.claim: 2025-04-18 / pre-closing: Discover and DFS Services LLC entered the Federal Reserve consent order on the Card Product Misclassification (disclosed July 19, 2023); the civil money penalty was paid before closing and Capital One and CONA committed to satisfy the order's obligations.
claims.quote: On April 18, 2025, Discover and DFS Services LLC entered into a consent order with the Federal Reserve
claims.title: Capital One Financial Corporation Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
claims.publisher: Capital One Financial Corporation via SEC EDGAR
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: 10-K also notes the December 2020 CFPB student-loan order remains in effect until December 2030.

claims.claim: 2025-07-30: A court granted preliminary approval of Discover's settlement of merchant class actions over the Card Product Misclassification; Discover reserved $1.2 billion and the settlement is the primary channel for restitution to merchants, acquirers and intermediaries.
claims.quote: The court granted preliminary approval of the settlement on July 30, 2025.
claims.title: Capital One Financial Corporation Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
claims.publisher: Capital One Financial Corporation via SEC EDGAR
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Full sentence seen: 'Discover reserved $ 1.2 billion related to this matter and the class action settlement will be the primary means through which restitution will be paid to adversely affected merchants, merchant acquirers and other intermediaries.'

claims.claim: 2026-05-20: The court granted final approval of the merchant class settlement over the Discover Card Product Misclassification.
claims.quote: The court granted final approval of the settlement on May 20, 2026.
claims.title: Capital One Financial Corporation Form 10-Q for quarter ended June 30, 2026
claims.publisher: Capital One Financial Corporation via SEC EDGAR
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: 10-Q says restitution 'is being paid' to affected merchants, acquirers and intermediaries.

claims.claim: 2026-03-13 / 2026-04-30: In the shareholder securities class action over the misclassification, the court allowed an amended complaint on March 13, 2026 and Capital One moved to dismiss on April 30, 2026; an SEC investigation into the matter was also disclosed.
claims.quote: On March 13, 2026, the court granted the plaintiff’s request to file an amended complaint. On April 30, 2026, we filed a motion to dismiss
claims.title: Capital One Financial Corporation Form 10-Q for quarter ended June 30, 2026
claims.publisher: Capital One Financial Corporation via SEC EDGAR
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: 10-K FY2025: 'Discover was also subject to an SEC investigation into the Card Product Misclassification matter. We are cooperating with the investigation.'

claims.claim: By 2026-02-19 (FY2025 10-K): Capital One had substantially completed reissuing legacy Capital One debit cards onto the Global Payment Network, i.e. moving its debit portfolio from Mastercard to Discover/PULSE.
claims.quote: The Company has substantially completed the reissuance of legacy Capital One customer debit cards onto the Global Payment Network.
claims.title: Capital One Financial Corporation Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
claims.publisher: Capital One Financial Corporation via SEC EDGAR
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Major volume event for acquirers, processors and PULSE participants. FY2025 Global Payment Network volume reported as $401,775 million (partial year from May 18, 2025).

claims.claim: Q2 2026: Global Payment Network volume was $189.6 billion in the quarter versus $74.0 billion in Q2 2025 (up 156%), with non-interest income lifted by the debit reissuance onto the network.
claims.quote: impacts from the reissuance of legacy Capital One customer debit cards onto the Global Payment Network
claims.title: Capital One Financial Corporation Form 10-Q for quarter ended June 30, 2026
claims.publisher: Capital One Financial Corporation via SEC EDGAR
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Table seen: 'Global Payment Network volume 189,612 74,014 156' (Q2 2026 vs Q2 2025, $ millions); six months 363,944. Q2 2025 figure covers only May 18 to June 30, 2025.

claims.claim: FY2025 10-K risk language names the partner-side risks Capital One now carries: loss of large merchants on Discover Network or PULSE, network participant outages, and non-contracted small merchants who can leave on short notice.
claims.quote: may cease to participate in our Discover Network and PULSE Network at any time on short notice
claims.title: Capital One Financial Corporation Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
claims.publisher: Capital One Financial Corporation via SEC EDGAR
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Also: 'defaults or risks from bankruptcies, liquidations, restructurings, consolidations and outages by our network participants'.

claims.claim: 2026-04-13: Payments Dive reported Capital One was eliminating more than 100 Discover application engineer jobs as it integrates the card business.
claims.quote: As Capital One integrates the card business, it’s eliminating more than 100 application engineer jobs.
claims.title: Search | Payments Dive (result: Which Discover jobs are disappearing, Lynne Marek)
claims.label: Reported
claims.note: Only the search-result listing was read; the article URL could not be resolved.

claims.claim: 2026-07-30: Payments Dive reported Capital One issued a progress report on the $265 billion Community Benefits Plan tied to the Discover deal, with little support from partner charities.
claims.quote: The bank issued a report last month on progress related to the $265 billion it had committed to invest
claims.title: Search | Payments Dive (result: Capital One gives update on Discover community investment plan, Tatiana Walk-Morris)
claims.label: Reported

claims.claim: 2026-04-03: Nilson Report data cited by Payments Dive showed U.S. volume on Visa, Mastercard, American Express and Discover cards rose 6.4% in 2025 over 2024.
claims.quote: Volume on Visa, Mastercard, American Express and Discover cards issued in the U.S. climbed 6.4% last year over 2024
claims.title: Search | Payments Dive (result: Card volume rises with digital boost, Lynne Marek)
claims.label: Reported

claims.quote: Newsroom Capital One's latest news, media contacts, awards and more
